capabilities.target: HR policy search index (published policies only)

capabilities.tool_ref: chat reply channel (agent's final answer to the employee)

inputs.source: Employee question submitted via SSO-authenticated chat session
Published HR policy documents in the policy search index, authored by the HR content team under two-person review

instructions.note: The prohibition on giving legal advice is enforced only through a prompt instruction with no technical guardrail. Impact is limited because the agent's only data source is narrowly scoped, published HR policy text.

elements.name: HR content team (policy publisher, two-person review)
Employee question entering the agent via SSO chat
Policy content read from the index into the agent's context
Agent reply delivered to the employee's chat session

controls.name: Read-only credential scoped to the policy index
Two-person review required to publish policy content
SSO authentication for the employee chat session
Chat reply routed only to the authenticated requester's own session
Chat client does not render images or auto-fetch links
Network egress denied at the network layer, verified by penetration test
Model version pinned; upgrade requires a change ticket
System prompt instruction not to give legal advice
controls.decay_rationale: Relies entirely on the model choosing to follow the instruction; a more capable or adversarially steered model could rationalize an exception and still issue advice framed as a policy quote.

controls.name: Tamper-evident log of each Q&A exchange with requester identity
Per-user rate limit on policy_search invocations

findings.title: Internal policy content read then quoted back to the requesting employee

attack_path.note: Agent reads the matching policy from the index.
Agent quotes the policy back to the requester's own chat session.

evidence.observation: Replies go only to the authenticated requester's chat session; the chat client does not render images or auto-fetch links, closing the main side channel for exfiltration via rendered content.
The policy index holds only published, internal-sensitivity policy content; only the HR content team can write to it and publishing requires two-person review.
The agent is instructed to use policy_search and quote the relevant policy back to the requester, which is the read-then-reply pattern this finding documents.

forecast.watch_signal: A configuration change that removes session-bound recipient routing or allows the model to choose an arbitrary reply destination.

findings.title: No attributable record of employee questions or the policy answers given

evidence.observation: No logging, audit trail, or record-keeping of employee questions, search queries, or quoted policy text is described anywhere in the artifacts.
The system prompt defines the agent's behavior but includes no instruction to record or attribute the interaction to the requester for later review.

recommendations.action: Implement a tamper-evident log capturing each employee question, the search query issued, the policy content returned, and the requester's identity, retained for compliance review.

forecast.watch_signal: The agent's scope expands to confidential individual HR data (for example personal leave or pay records), or autonomy is raised beyond A3, without adding audit logging first.

findings.title: No rate limit or quota on policy_search invocations

evidence.observation: policy_search.search takes a free-text query with no stated per-user or per-session invocation limit.
No rate limit, quota, or spend cap on policy_search invocations is described.

recommendations.action: Add a per-user rate limit or quota on policy_search invocations to bound compute cost and prevent abusive querying.

forecast.watch_signal: Median queries per session or autonomous loop steps rising, or the agent being deployed in a bulk or batch mode without per-user limits.

stride_coverage.rationale: The agent exposes no agent card, MCP server, or A2A interface; it is reached only through the organization's authenticated chat platform, so there is no separate agent identity to spoof.
The artifacts do not describe how policy_search.search's own tool definition is deployed, versioned, or protected from unauthorized change.
The two-person review gate for publishing is described, but whether reviewer identities are recorded in an auditable log is not stated in the artifacts.
The index serves a single-tenant organization's employees only; there is no multi-tenant boundary for retrieval to cross incorrectly.
Transport-level integrity protection for the SSO-authenticated chat channel carrying the employee's question is not described in the artifacts.
Encryption in transit and any logging of the chat channel's payloads are not described in the artifacts.
Integrity protection on the internal connection between the policy index and the agent's read calls is not documented in the artifacts.
Encryption and access logging for the internal read path between the policy index and the agent are not described in the artifacts.
Integrity protection for the reply message between the agent and the employee's chat client is not described in the artifacts.
A single reply per question creates no distinct resource-exhaustion vector beyond the query volume already captured for policy_search.

rating.rationale: Inherent risk is moderate, driven by internal published-policy content reaching the requesting employee through the chat reply (I x S2) and by the absence of any attributable record of what was told to whom. The autonomy modifier was not applied even though max_unattended_steps and max_runtime_minutes are unstated, because the design exposes exactly one tool and operates as a single-turn request/response flow per employee question with no looping, spawning, or self-configuration; this is a documented judgment call per rubric guidance. Residual stays at moderate because the destination-bound reply control, the no-rendering control, the scoped read-only credential, and the verified network egress block together sever the main disclosure path to low, but no control restores the missing audit trail, which is tracked as its own property finding. Forecast rises to high because if the agent's data scope expands to more sensitive HR data, or autonomy increases, without first adding audit logging, the repudiation gap would then sit behind a materially more sensitive sink.

limitations: This assessment reflects the agent's declared design and configuration as described in the provided artifacts (system prompt, tool manifest, and runtime notes), not observed runtime behavior; no logs, traces, or live testing were reviewed.

The artifacts do not state autonomy.max_unattended_steps or max_runtime_minutes; the inherent risk rating does not apply the autonomy modifier because the architecture exposes exactly one tool and operates as a single-turn request/response Q&A flow, a judgment documented in rating.rationale.
The artifacts do not describe logging, audit trail, or transport encryption practices, which limits confidence on the repudiation finding to medium.
No MCP or A2A protocol configuration was provided; the single declared tool is treated as a first-party, in-process function without a separate protocol trust boundary.
